article.title_es: AIDS Center of Queens County: despensa de alimentos en Woodside
article.title_en: AIDS Center of Queens County: food pantry in Woodside
article.summary_es: El AIDS Center of Queens County (sede de Woodside) aparece en el mapa Food Help NYC como despensa de alimentos. Abre los martes de 8am a 10am.
article.summary_en: AIDS Center of Queens County (Woodside location) is listed on the City's Food Help NYC map as a food pantry. It is open Tuesdays 8am-10am.
how_they_help_es: Aparece en el mapa Food Help NYC como despensa de alimentos.
Está ubicada en 62-07 Woodside Ave, Woodside, Queens, NY 11377.
Puede llamar al (718) 472-9400 para preguntar antes de ir.
how_they_help_en: Listed on the Food Help NYC map as a food pantry.
Located at 62-07 Woodside Ave, Woodside, Queens, NY 11377.
You can call (718) 472-9400 to ask before going.
visit_tips_es: La despensa abre solo los martes de 8am a 10am; llegue dentro de ese horario.
No se indica qué alimentos entrega ni si hay requisitos; pregunte por teléfono al (718) 472-9400.
La información fue verificada por última vez el 10 de octubre de 2026; confirme los horarios antes de ir.
visit_tips_en: The pantry is open only Tuesdays 8am-10am; go during those hours.
What food is given and any requirements are not listed; call (718) 472-9400 to ask.
Information was last checked on October 10, 2026; confirm hours before going.
